activity.boundary: Finite branch and stream branch validate cursor before discovery; stream transport and watch-JSON refusal retain prior priority.

adapter.boundary: Labels/install hash are pure; Event key depends on PreToolUse input; config/protocol/bindings are separate.

work.boundary: Agent registration/report and transition reasons are pure. Check Run missing key is Clap plus library guard. Registered lookup IDs, leases, CAS, task/check existence are dynamic.

checkpoint.boundary: Create name/glob scopes validated; Delete/List IDs remain lookup grammar.

context.boundary: Get mode/full-since/scope and Ack provenance validated; current session/receipt/policy are dynamic.

operations.boundary: Queue/Inbox bounds, exactly-one recipient, Resolve evidence and restrictions validated. Registered recipient aliases remain lookup-dependent; raw JSON is G03-D04.

extract.boundary: Location syntax, path/line pairing, view/unit/source requirement; output artifact/source existence remain dynamic.

filter.boundary: Activate ID, Explain bounded argv, relative UTF8 paths; absolute paths interpreted against actual project root.

search.boundary: Search/structure limits and selectors, Read exclusivity/line/path, Outline freshness/scopes; source/symbol IDs remain dynamic.

graph.boundary: Direction/depth and lexical path before graph/source access.

handoff.boundary: Create/Show/Update name grammar shared; caller payload is G03-D04 and checkpoint content remains producer-owned.

inventory.boundary: Profile/Audit/optional Scan lexical paths; supplied expiry remains before scan work.

runner.boundary: Job/Helper private IDs and HelperRequest mode/scope grammar; key/task/run lookup unrestricted. Operational capacity floors are explicit separate prelaunch failure8.

output.boundary: Output IDs, full/compact selectors, line ranges and literal/limit; metadata/artifact lookup separate.

pack.boundary: Plan scope/content/budget/split and Create plan ID; output normalization follows policy and artifacts/plans remain dynamic.

quota.boundary: Report/Plan/Reconcile/Reserve arguments and Ingest key; usage JSON and observation lookup remain G03-D04/producer.

repo.boundary: Fields and workspace selection pure; Git/current cache/registration dynamic.

run.boundary: Modes/bounded argv are grammar;3000byte metadata floor is BUDGET_TOO_SMALL8 prelaunch failure.

schedule.boundary: Labels/RFC3339/loop bounds/reason/plan checked; RunLoop namespace/purpose eligible-tick exception and Inspect/Uninstall unrestricted lookup retained.

session.boundary: Attach identities and Suspend/Boundary reasons pure; reconcile/session existence dynamic.

build.boundary: Task-source exclusivity/presence, detail/depth and tokenizer unsupported6; body/task lookup separate.

trust.boundary: Bounded argv pure; actual executable/owner/trust binding dynamic.

parser_only.validator: Clap/representation/capacity admission; no additional source-independent producer grammar
